title: weather.forecast
description: Get N-day forecast for the configured location (AETHER_WEATHER_LAT/LON/LABEL env vars). Returns array of daily forecasts each with date, high/low temperatures in °F, plain-English conditions, precipitation probability %, and the underlying WMO weather code. Polled from Open-Meteo every 15 minutes (same fetch as weather.current); this surface returns the cached forecast slice. When env vars are unset, returns { available: false, reason: 'no_config' } rather than throwing — node operates in graceful-degradation mode consistent with auxiliary-writes-isolation (CLAUDE.md §11.8).

days.description: Number of forecast days to return (1-7). Default 3 if omitted; clamped to 7.
